interface Scores {
  [k: `math${number}`]: number;
  [k: `note${string}`]: string;
}
interface Overlap {
  [k: `a${string}`]: number | string;
  readonly [k: `ab${string}`]: number;
}
const s: Scores = { math1: 90, noteA: "good" };
s.math2 = 80;
s["noteB"] = "ok";
const total: number = s.math1 + s["math2"];
console.log(total, s.noteA.toUpperCase(), s.noteB);
type First<T extends Scores> = T["math1"];
const first: First<Scores> = 5;
console.log(first);
const copy = { ...s };
console.log(copy.math1, Object.keys(copy).join(","));
const { math1, ...rest } = s;
console.log(math1, rest.noteA.length);
const key: keyof Scores = "math3";
console.log(key);
const o: Overlap = { a1: "x", ab1: 2 };
o.a1 = 3;
const ab: number = o.ab1;
console.log(o.a1, ab + 1);
function read<T extends Scores>(t: T): number {
  return t.math1 * 2;
}
console.log(read(s));
